messages:
sophia.ae: Quick heads-up — Whitestone wants to convert the POC to prod. They asked if we can do a bespoke commit to get their TCO down. Asking for guidance before I propose.
mikael.se: What does the workload look like? bursty realtime chat + nightly batch embeddings, right?
sophia.ae: Yep. Expected steady-state ~120M tokens/mo, spikes to ~600M in BlackFriday-style periods. Wants dedicated pool option and private VPC eventually. Current POC used hosted API.
james.deal-desk: Give me the ask so I can run margin. % off and commit term?
sophia.ae: They're pushing for 45% off list on hosted inference for 12 months with a $240k committed spend (billed monthly). Add-on: optional Private deployment + 3-node reserved pool for an extra fixed fee. Also want a clause for scale-up pricing if usage >2x for 2 consecutive months.
pricing-bot: Cost calc: at 45% off + $240k commit, projected CAC-adjusted margin = 18% before infra discounts. Private deploy add-on reduces per-token revenue but increases ARR stability.
james.deal-desk: 18% margin is tight. Finance will push back on 45%. Can you ask if they will do 36% off with a 24-month commit or keep 12m + $300k commit?
sophia.ae: I can try the 36%/24m or 12m/$300k split. Whitestone prefers shorter term but needs price certainty for budgeting.
mikael.se: Technical blocker: they require SOC2 attestation and customer-managed KMS for Private. Also need allowed-listing of subnets and egress control. Can we confirm any extra fees for the KMS/HSM integration?
oliver.legal: For Private/VPC we need to add DPA + security appendix. Also flag: bespoke pricing with rollback/early-termination clauses — we need to limit credits if they exit early. I'll draft a short addendum.
tara.finance: Finance note: for enterprise sales we have a floor of 25% for hosted unless accompanied by a high-commit or multi-year. 36% might be approvable if commit >= $350k or 24m term. Also need ARR coverage for cost of reserved GPU nodes.
james.deal-desk: Approvals path: 1) deal desk (me) signs off margin 2) finance signs 3) legal signs terms. Conditional approval possible if sales agrees to the 36%/24m option or we get $300k+ for 12m. @sophia.ae, can you confirm which counter to present?
sophia.ae: I'll propose two counters: A) 36% off for 24 months with standard private add-on fees and KMS surcharge; B) 12 months at 40% off with $320k commit + early-exit credit taper. Ask tech if KMS surcharge is acceptable.
mikael.se: KMS surcharge: estimate a one-time integration fee + ~0.5% uplift on per-token for the duration. Private pool sizing: recommend 3 reserved GPUs with autoscaling burst; estimate cost to us then pass-through in addendum.
pricing-bot: If choose counter A: projected margin = 24%. Counter B: projected margin = 21% with early-exit exposure. Both better than 18% base.
james.deal-desk: OK. I can provisionally approve counter A subject to finance + legal signoff. If they insist on 12m, escalate to revenue ops for exec approval.
oliver.legal: I'll prepare the DPA + early-exit taper language and standard KMS clause. Need final numbers for the private pool fees to finish the addendum.
tara.finance: Once Sophia confirms counter chosen, send me the final price sheet and expected spend cadence. I'll run the final margin model and confirm by EOD tomorrow.
sophia.ae: Will send updated proposal by EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
james.deal-desk: tagging in case anyone else — @tara.finance @oliver.legal. We'll keep this thread as the approval record.
pricing-bot: note: record created for deal id WL-2026-091. Auto-attach price calc to thread.
